description: This file defines a lightweight data transfer object (DTO) class EmailListItem, representing summary information of an email message, with properties such as id, sender, recipients, subject, preview, flags (read, starred, archived, deleted), and timestamps (updated, received, sent). It includes getter and setter methods and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmailListItem
classes.description: Data transfer object representing a simplified email list item with metadata and status flags.

methods.name: getPreview
methods.description: Returns the preview snippet of the email.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the email has been read.

methods.name: isStarred
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is starred.

methods.name: isArchived
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is archived.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the email is deleted.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was last updated.

methods.name: getReceivedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was received.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was sent.
